SCENARIO: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials and verify the error is user-friendly
PRECONDITIONS: User is on the Login page
STEPS: 1. Enter an unregistered email + wrong password | 2. Click "Login"
EXPECTED RESULT: App shows an error message (e.g., "Invalid credentials") and stays on Login page; no token is saved

SCENARIO: Log in with valid local credentials
PRECONDITIONS: A local user account already exists
STEPS: 1. Enter valid email/password | 2. Click "Login"
EXPECTED RESULT: Redirects to dashboard.html; token saved in localStorage; user name shown in top bar

SCENARIO: Register a new account successfully
PRECONDITIONS: User is on the Login page; email not yet used
STEPS: 1. Click "Register" tab | 2. Enter name/email/password | 3. Click "Create Account"
EXPECTED RESULT: Account is created; auto-login happens; redirects to dashboard.html; token saved

SCENARIO: Register using an already-registered email
PRECONDITIONS: A user with the email already exists
STEPS: 1. Click "Register" tab | 2. Use an existing email | 3. Click "Create Account"
EXPECTED RESULT: App shows error (e.g., "Email already exists"); user remains on Register form

SCENARIO: Register with too-short password
PRECONDITIONS: User is on Register tab
STEPS: 1. Enter name/email | 2. Enter password < 6 chars | 3. Click "Create Account"
EXPECTED RESULT: Form is blocked by validation or shows error (e.g., "Password must be at least 6 characters"); account not created

SCENARIO: Log in with Google successfully (new or existing Google account)
PRECONDITIONS: Google OAuth is configured for the environment; user is logged out
STEPS: 1. Click "Login with Google" | 2. Choose Google account | 3. Approve consent
EXPECTED RESULT: Redirects back to app; token saved; redirects to dashboard.html

SCENARIO: Log in with Google again and verify it signs in the same user
PRECONDITIONS: User has already used Google login before
STEPS: 1. Log out | 2. Click "Login with Google" | 3. Use the same Google account
TEST DATA: Same Google account as prior test
EXPECTED RESULT: User is logged in successfully; app shows correct user name; no duplicate account behavior visible

SCENARIO: Request password reset for an existing email
PRECONDITIONS: SMTP is configured; local account exists
STEPS: 1. Click "Forgot password?" | 2. Enter user email | 3. Click "Send Reset Link"
EXPECTED RESULT: Success message shown; reset email arrives with a reset link

SCENARIO: Request password reset for a non-existing email (privacy check)
PRECONDITIONS: SMTP is configured
STEPS: 1. Click "Forgot password?" | 2. Enter an email not in the system | 3. Click "Send Reset Link"
EXPECTED RESULT: Same success message is shown (doesn’t reveal if account exists)

SCENARIO: Reset password with mismatched confirmation
PRECONDITIONS: Tester has a valid reset link open (contains resetToken)
STEPS: 1. Enter new password | 2. Enter different confirm password | 3. Click "Reset Password"
EXPECTED RESULT: App shows "Passwords do not match"; reset does not proceed

SCENARIO: Reset password with invalid/expired token
PRECONDITIONS: Tester opens reset page with an invalid/expired resetToken
STEPS: 1. Enter new password + confirm (match) | 2. Click "Reset Password"
EXPECTED RESULT: App shows error (e.g., "Reset token is invalid or expired") and stays on reset flow

SCENARIO: Reset password successfully with valid token
PRECONDITIONS: Tester has a valid reset link open
STEPS: 1. Enter new password + confirm (match) | 2. Click "Reset Password" | 3. Log in using the new password
EXPECTED RESULT: Success message shown; user returns to Login; login works with the new password

SCENARIO: Prevent access to dashboard when not authenticated
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged out (no token in localStorage)
STEPS: 1. Directly open dashboard.html
EXPECTED RESULT: App redirects to index.html (Login page)

SCENARIO: Log out from the app
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in
STEPS: 1. Click "Logout" from sidebar or Profile modal | 2. Confirm logout
EXPECTED RESULT: Token cleared; user redirected to Login page; protected pages can’t be accessed

SCENARIO: Change password with wrong current password
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in with a local account
STEPS: 1. Open "Profile Settings" | 2. Enter wrong current password | 3. Enter new password + confirm | 4. Click "Change Password"
EXPECTED RESULT: Error shown (e.g., "Current password is incorrect"); password not changed

SCENARIO: Change password successfully
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in with a local account
STEPS: 1. Open "Profile Settings" | 2. Enter correct current password | 3. Enter new password + confirm | 4. Click "Change Password" | 5. Log out + log back in with new password
EXPECTED RESULT: Success message shown; login works with new password afterward

SCENARIO: Add an expense and verify dashboard updates
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; at least 1 category exists
STEPS: 1. Click "Add Expense" | 2. Select category | 3. Enter amount/date/description | 4. Submit
EXPECTED RESULT: Expense is added; modal closes; totals update (expenses up, balance down); transaction appears in lists

SCENARIO: Add income and verify dashboard updates
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in
STEPS: 1. Click "Input Monthly Income" | 2. Enter amount/date/source | 3. Submit
EXPECTED RESULT: Income is added; totals update (income up, balance up); transaction appears in lists

SCENARIO: Add savings and verify savings total updates
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in
STEPS: 1. Click "Add Savings" | 2. Enter amount/date/note | 3. Submit
EXPECTED RESULT: Savings transaction saved as an expense with category "Savings"; savings total updates; item appears in lists

SCENARIO: Delete a transaction from All Transactions
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; at least 1 transaction exists
STEPS: 1. Go to "Transactions" page | 2. Click trash icon on a row | 3. Confirm delete
EXPECTED RESULT: Transaction is removed; dashboard totals reflect the deletion

SCENARIO: Add a new category and verify it’s available for selection
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in
STEPS: 1. Go to "Add Category" page | 2. Fill name/icon/color | 3. Submit
EXPECTED RESULT: Category is created; shows in category list; appears in Add Expense + Set Budget dropdowns

SCENARIO: Delete a category and verify related budgets/transactions are handled
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; category has budgets and transactions
STEPS: 1. Create a category | 2. Create budget for it | 3. Add a transaction using it | 4. Delete the category
EXPECTED RESULT: Category removed; related budgets removed; related transactions change category to "Uncategorized"

SCENARIO: Set a budget and verify spent/remaining/progress
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; category exists
STEPS: 1. Go to "Manage Budget" page | 2. Select a category | 3. Enter allocated amount | 4. Save budget | 5. Add an expense under that category | 6. Re-check budget card
EXPECTED RESULT: Budget shows allocated/spent/remaining; after expense, spent up and remaining down; progress bar updates

SCENARIO: Export CSV data and verify file contents
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; transactions exist
STEPS: 1. Click "Export Data" | 2. Open downloaded CSV
EXPECTED RESULT: Downloads expense-tracker-data.csv; includes header and correct transaction rows

SCENARIO: Export Transactions (print/PDF) from Transactions page
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; on Transactions page
STEPS: 1. Click "Export Transactions"
EXPECTED RESULT: Browser print dialog opens; transaction table is printable/exportable to PDF

SCENARIO: Submit a suggestion successfully
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; SMTP configured for Suggestions
STEPS: 1. Go to "About" page | 2. Fill suggestion form | 3. Submit
TEST DATA: Type=bug | Message=Export button overlaps on mobile
EXPECTED RESULT: Success message shown (e.g., "Suggestion sent. Thank you!"); no form errors

SCENARIO: Validate suggestion form requires a message
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; on About page
STEPS: 1. Leave message empty | 2. Click "Submit"
EXPECTED RESULT: Error shown (e.g., "Please write a suggestion..."); submission blocked

SCENARIO: Upload profile picture successfully
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; profile upload configured (S3/Firebase)
STEPS: 1. Open "Profile Settings" | 2. Choose a valid image file | 3. Click "Upload Picture"
EXPECTED RESULT: Success message shown; avatar updates; persists after refresh

SCENARIO: Reject invalid profile picture (type/size)
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in
STEPS: 1. Open "Profile Settings" | 2. Choose invalid type OR >2MB file | 3. Upload
EXPECTED RESULT: Clear error shown (type not allowed or size too large); no upload performed

SCENARIO: Mobile view: bottom nav items are aligned and uniform (Export included)
PRECONDITIONS: User is logged in; viewport <= 768px
STEPS: 1. Open app in mobile size | 2. Look at bottom nav | 3. Verify Export icon alignment
EXPECTED RESULT: All nav icons (Dashboard/Budget/Category/Transactions/About/Export) stay on one row, evenly sized, no wrapping
